rules.name: discovery is not authorization
rules.requirement: Presence in any upstream API, service, MCP or tool catalog is discovery metadata only and MUST NOT authorize registration, invocation or execution.

rules.name: untrusted metadata boundary
rules.requirement: Descriptions, URLs, auth claims, CORS claims, schemas and capability labels from upstream catalogs MUST be treated as untrusted input until locally verified.

rules.name: immutable source snapshot
rules.requirement: Every admitted discovery candidate MUST retain source identity plus immutable commit/snapshot identity; floating branches are not promotion evidence.

rules.name: normalization and deduplication
rules.requirement: Multi-source candidates MUST be normalized and deduplicated by provider-neutral identity before policy or registry admission.

rules.name: license and terms admission
rules.requirement: Runtime use MUST fail closed until applicable repository/content/service licence and terms are assessed and admitted; missing licence information is not permission.

rules.name: endpoint protocol schema verification
rules.requirement: Endpoint reachability, transport security, protocol version and advertised schema/tool surface MUST be independently verified before admission.

rules.name: secret boundary
rules.requirement: Discovery metadata MAY declare required auth type but MUST NOT ingest or persist secret values; credentials remain under the canonical secrets authority.

rules.name: egress boundary
rules.requirement: Provider URLs never authorize egress. Canonical egress approval plus SSRF and DNS-rebinding resistance are required before network probes or runtime calls.

rules.name: provider-neutral capability mapping
rules.requirement: External labels MUST map to existing FA3 capability IDs/contracts and MUST NOT create vendor-defined canonical capabilities.

rules.name: sandbox probe before admission
rules.requirement: Registry admission requires bounded sandbox probing with positive and negative conformance evidence and local policy approval.

rules.name: MCP auto-registration forbidden
rules.requirement: An MCP catalog entry MUST NOT be auto-registered into the Central MCP/Capability Gateway and MUST NOT self-declare execution authority.

rules.name: source failure isolation
rules.requirement: Catalog outage, stale metadata, sponsorship changes or source drift MUST NOT replace canonical registry state or cause fail-open execution.

rules.name: source non-authority
rules.requirement: Discovery and UI pattern sources remain non-root, non-provider and non-authoritative; capability count remains 143.
